title: Context-Adaptive Interface Generator — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Reorganizes interfaces around the current task, device, accessibility needs, and user preferences. A proposed generator that reshapes interfaces around context: the current task, the device in hand, the user accessibility needs, and learned preferences. The same application presents a driving mode, a desk mode, and a low-vision mode — each genuinely suited to its context, not just resized.
capabilities: Detect the current task, device, and context
Reorganize interfaces around the task
Adapt to accessibility needs automatically
Learn preferences without trapping users in them
Let users pin or override any adaptation
